current_evidence: The council's 'Apply for planning permission' page (article/1917, last modified 29 March 2022) and its planning guide page have no validation list. Site and web searches found none, and MHCLG's planning.data.gov.uk record for St Helens local area requirements (entity 20327) notes 'Couldn't find any sort of checklist'.

issues.detail: Grokbot's 'Validation list URL' is the generic 'Your guide to planning & building Control' page, last modified 8 September 2022. It explains planning versus Building Regulations and pre-application advice. It does not contain or link to a validation checklist or local list.
issues.evidence: Page links only to a 'Pre-application form', a 'Pre Application charging schedule' (Apr26) and Planning Portal guidance; 'Last modified on 08 September 2022'

issues.detail: Grokbot's status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)', and the matching notes on all 18 app_type_rows, are inaccurate. The page loads normally; it is simply not a local list. As far as can be found, St Helens does not publish a local validation list, so the status should read 'no local list published', with national requirements only.
issues.evidence: planning.data.gov.uk entity 20327 (local-area-requirements:st-helens): notes 'Couldn't find any sort of checklist.'

issues.detail: 'Planning page' is just the council homepage (https://www.sthelens.gov.uk). The relevant page is 'Apply for planning permission' (https://www.sthelens.gov.uk/article/1917/Apply-for-planning-permission). It sets out only basic submission documents for the email route: elevations at 1:50 or 1:100, a 1:1250 location plan edged red, a 1:500 block plan and the fee. It has no local list.
issues.evidence: article/1917: 'You will need to submit' elevations, location plan, block plan and fee; 'Last modified on 29 March 2022'

issues.detail: The URL source is a third-party directory (planninggeek.co.uk) that was not verified, and the directory pointed to a page with no validation content.
issues.evidence: reference_row 'URL source': 'planninggeek.co.uk directory (third-party; not verified on this run)'

summary: Grokbot's St Helens link is a generic planning and building control guide page, not a validation list, and it is readable rather than blocked. No official St Helens local validation list could be found: the council's apply page lists only basic plans and the fee, and MHCLG's planning data also records no checklist.
